prompt: Complete the sentence about reaching the Cluster Manager UI.
explanation: After installation you browse to https://<node-address>:8443, accept the self-signed certificate warning, and either create a new cluster or sign in to an existing one. Port 8443 is the default Cluster Manager UI port; the REST API lives on 9443/8080 and is not used for the browser UI.
template: To open the Cluster Manager UI on an installed node, point a browser at https://<node-address>:___ and sign in with the cluster credentials.
